node.statement: Because L_{sJ}=sI, C=phi_{sJ}(W)=s(W-sJ) has norm below 2delta and its Hermitian and anti-Hermitian parts do too. Put B=C^par. Since W=sJ bold-dot(J+C) is unitary, the defining expression gives f_{sJ}(C)=0; uniqueness in lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control forces C^perp=G(B). Thus W=chi_s(B) in the same chart, B=phi_{sJ}^par(W)=F_s(A), and B,F_s are C1.
